source: Aucune maquette de collectivité dans la bibliothèque ni dans les documents : gabarit déduit des plus proches, castelactu (actualité locale, « jamais un lieu réel du pays »), fanfare-dongelberg (village, carrière, église), esaie-55-1 (association), observatoire-des-cse (salle de réunion vide), elka (paysage local sans pylônes ni bâtiments modernes).
style: Editorial documentary photography for a local public service, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, calm and credible, generous negative space.
interdits: No town hall, church, monument or street that could be taken for the real one, no coat of arms, no flag, no elected official, no political symbol, no road sign, no recognizable face.
evite: Évite de montrer un faux bâtiment communal ou un lieu reconnaissable comme s'il était réel : paysages, matières et objets du service public, génériques et légendés « Illustration générée ».

404.consigne: A wooden signpost at a country crossroads with completely blank arms, morning mist, a grass path in each direction, a gentle touch of humour.
404.source: motif des 404 réussies, règle « no road signs »
404.evite: Le panneau portant un nom de lieu.

ouverture.consigne: Wide landscape of {sujet} at dawn, low mist in the valleys, hedgerows and a few isolated trees, soft warm light, {lieu} countryside only, no power lines, no pylons, no modern buildings, not a recognizable real place.
ouverture.source: elka-a-refaire (paysage qui a marché), castelactu (règle des lieux)
ouverture.evite: Le clocher ou la mairie reconnaissables.

section-fond.consigne: A quiet village square at first light, generic pale stone facades softly out of focus, wet paving, a single bench, nobody, no shop signs, an atmospheric mood image, not a specific real place.

scene-metier.consigne: Top-down view of {sujet} on a wooden table: a closed folder, blank forms with abstract unreadable lines, a pen and a cup of coffee, morning light, nothing readable.

lieu.consigne: An empty public meeting room in early morning: rows of simple chairs, a long table, tall windows, {lumiere}, nobody, no flag, no emblem.
lieu.evite: Le conseil municipal mis en scène.

texture.consigne: Close-up of {matieres} of an old wall, raking morning light revealing the relief, filling the whole frame, no objects.

portrait-generique.consigne: A few residents seen from behind walking along a tree-lined path in the soft morning light, small in the frame, slightly out of focus, no faces.
